title: "ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version' from 'google.protobuf'" when developing on MacOS
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When developing Streamlit on Mac following the [Contributing section in the Wiki](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/wiki/Contributing) and I ran `streamlit hello`, I encountered this error:
```
❯ streamlit hello
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/venv/bin/streamlit", line 33, in <module>
    sys.exit(load_entry_point('streamlit', 'console_scripts', 'streamlit')())
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/venv/bin/streamlit", line 25, in importlib_load_entry_point
    return next(matches).load()
  File "/path/to/pyenv/versions/3.10.6/lib/python3.10/importlib/metadata/__init__.py", line 171, in load
    module = import_module(match.group('module'))
  File "/path/to/pyenv/versions/3.10.6/lib/python3.10/importlib/__init__.py", line 126, in import_module
    return _bootstrap._gcd_import(name[level:], package, level)
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1050, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1027, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 992, in _find_and_load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 241, in _call_with_frames_removed
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1050, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1027, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 992, in _find_and_load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 241, in _call_with_frames_removed
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1050, in _gcd_import
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1027, in _find_and_load
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 1006, in _find_and_load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 688, in _load_unlocked
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap_external>", line 883, in exec_module
  File "<frozen importlib._bootstrap>", line 241, in _call_with_frames_removed
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/streamlit/__init__.py", line 68, in <module>
    from streamlit.delta_generator import (
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/streamlit/delta_generator.py", line 37, in <module>
    from streamlit import (
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/streamlit/cursor.py", line 20, in <module>
    from streamlit.runtime.scriptrunner import get_script_run_ctx
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/streamlit/runtime/__init__.py", line 17, in <module>
    from streamlit.runtime.runtime import Runtime, RuntimeConfig, RuntimeState
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/streamlit/runtime/runtime.py", line 27, in <module>
    from streamlit.proto.ForwardMsg_pb2 import ForwardMsg
  File "/workspace/streamlit/lib/streamlit/proto/ForwardMsg_pb2.py", line 9, in <module>
    from google.protobuf import runtime_version as _runtime_version
ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version' from 'google.protobuf' (/workspace/streamlit/lib/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/google/protobuf/__init__.py)
```

It seems because `protobuf` released its new version [27.1](https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/releases/tag/v27.1) recently and the `protobuf` formula for Homebrew has been updated to it.
After I ran `brew reinstall protobuf@3`, this problem was solved.

So the document https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/wiki/Contributing#macos should be updated.

### Reproducible Code Example

_No response_

### Steps To Reproduce

Follow https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/wiki/Contributing on MacOS, and run `streamlit hello.

Hi [USER] and  [USER],

I'd like to help move this issue forward. I noticed the repository currently restricts pull requests to collaborators, so I wasn't able to open one directly.

In the meantime, I tested a fix locally on Apple Silicon (M4) and confirmed that pinning `protobuf@21` resolves the `runtime_version` ImportError described in this issue. I've pushed the change to my fork here:
[link](https://github.com/atharvasardarx/streamlit/commit/0a0d81c1711818ffa3646227c7ef0a0722d9cdb5)

Please feel free to apply this fix directly, or if it's easier, I'm happy to open a PR myself if temporary contributor access could be granted. Let me know whichever works best on your end.

The original Mac `ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version'` happened when Homebrew `protoc` generated code newer than the Python `protobuf` in the venv.

That is no longer an issue for normal Streamlit development. We require `protobuf>=5.26.1` (which includes `runtime_version`), and `uv.lock` currently pins `protobuf==6.33.6`, which matches Homebrew protobuf 33.x and also accepts older gencode such as CI's protoc 26.1.

Python only rejects gencode *newer* than the installed runtime. A much newer Homebrew protobuf than the lockfile can still fail that check, but that is an upgrade edge case, not the 2024 setup failure, and it does not require pinning `protoc` in the Mac install instructions. CONTRIBUTING troubleshooting now notes this.

Closing.
